invariants.name: No cyclic dependencies
invariants.description: Dependency graph must be acyclic. Circular imports or module cycles are not allowed.

invariants.name: Bounded context boundaries respected
invariants.description: Files in one bounded context may not import internals of another bounded context directly.

invariants.name: Outbound calls have resilience
invariants.description: Every network/IO call has a timeout, retry, or circuit-breaker policy.

invariants.name: LLM outputs validated
invariants.description: All structured LLM outputs are validated against a schema before use.
invariants.check: grep for .parse / .validate / zod usage near LLM call sites

invariants.name: Test coverage for critical paths
invariants.description: Every milestone's demo command must have an automated test or be manually verified and recorded.

notes: Run `graphify update .` after every code change to keep this graph current.
Add milestone-specific invariants as they become relevant.
